claim_rule: A claim node may exist only through the existing claim firewall and must cite explicit verified evidence nodes/runs plus scope/observer/protocol.
example_o7: O7 computation may yield a structural result node while the post-run review node QUALIFIES it as strong bounded direct-observer repeat evidence with certification debt; no SUPPORTS edge to O7_GRADUATED is permitted.
review_rule: Review decisions are immutable graph nodes that may qualify or block later transitions without rewriting source results.
separation: Evidence graph is distinct from computation graph and cannot be inferred automatically from producer dependencies.
status_preservation: OFormal/formal programmes retain sole graduation authority where frozen
